description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1611/25 of 24.07.2009, Homagama D/S Division and others amendments
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title amendments under the Registration of Title Act, specifically expunging particulars of specific land parcels in various locations. It contains detailed descriptions of land parcels (block numbers, cadastral maps, village names, administrative divisions) and concerns land registration matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel or structural content that would trigger Types 1-3, and the subject matter is specifically land-related rather than fitting any other specialized category.
